prompts.prompt: Rework this Jacob's Ladder 16-frame animation sheet with a MUCH BIGGER GROUND IMPACT and MUCH LOWER PIXEL RESOLUTION / COARSER PIXEL ART. Each frame MUST be designed as ONLY 32 pixels wide by 64 pixels tall, enlarged here as big crisp square pixels; absolutely no smooth painting, gradients, fine lines, antialiasing, glow haze or grain. Use only 5 flat colors: dark gold, amber, yellow, pale yellow, white. TRUE TRANSPARENT background. EXACTLY 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 sequential sustained looping frames, sheet aspect ratio 1:2. In each cell: a tall narrow golden TRAPEZOID downward light beam, FLAT TOP about 6 logical pixels wide and flat bottom about 12 pixels wide; beam height about 46 logical pixels. The lower QUARTER of the cell is a LARGE DRAMATIC IMPACT SPLASH OF LIGHT, about 28 pixels wide x 14 pixels tall: white-yellow impact core directly under the beam and two thick broad gold lobes that FLOW LEFT AND RIGHT, curl upward slightly, with big chunky horizontal shockwave tongues. The splash should be MORE THAN TWICE the beam's base width and much larger/thicker than the current thin ground ring. It reads like a powerful waterfall of light hitting invisible ground and pouring out sideways. Keep 2 transparent logical pixels at every edge. NO actual ground or scene. Only ONE OR TWO thick downward bright streaks inside the beam, and big chunky readable silhouette shifts as impact lobes surge outward over the 16 frames. Same anchor and overall dimensions for all frames. No pointed top, no realistic texture, no extra particles, no characters, no text, no labels, no gridlines. Extreme low-resolution retro game VFX, like hand-drawn 32px wide pixel sprites, NOT high resolution art rendered with a pixel filter.
